verdict.rationale: Slack's Block Kit is documented as the way to compose layouts for modals, messages, and tabs using structured JSON. chat.postMessage accepts a JSON array of structured blocks, which covers modals and structured message layouts first-party. However, the pack never explicitly mentions buttons or the handling of interactive callbacks, so interactivity is only implied. missing for 10: explicit evidence of buttons and other interactive elements, documentation of how interaction payloads are handled, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build apps with rich interactive UI inside chat — modals, buttons, and structured message layouts

citations.quote: Whether you're composing layouts for modals, messages, or tabs, the Block Kit building experience is the same — your app will be sculpting specially-structured JSON to express itself.
A JSON-based array of structured blocks, presented as a URL-encoded string.
